name: Melbourne: Route 96
source:
Part travel journal, part visual novel with a hint of psychological horror, Melbourne: Route 96 is an experimental game about catching a tram in the wrong direction.

"If you’re honest with your camera, then a polaroid will never lie. .."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2162540/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《墨尔本：96号公路》一半是旅行日记，一半是视觉小说，带有一丝心理恐怖，是一款关于搭错方向电车的实验性游戏。

“如果你对你的相机诚实，那么宝丽来就永远不会说谎……”

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2162540/]Steam[/url]]
